title: the RULE 1 check is a device-path check
intention: The RULE 1 check (encapsulation_holds) is a path check: code inside device bar may not import a module under cairn.devices.foo unless it is a tool foo publishes; nothing inside one device is checked and no charter's public_interface is read.
why: Outline 17.13.1 (Akien, Q#77, 2026-11-09): 'wouldn't it be easier (for the python code anyway) to see if the imports do not include other device paths?' Measured 2026-11-09: encapsulation_breaches over the live tree returns 79 rows, 76 into_device and 3 undeclared; the 3 are reaches the outline says are not breaches, and the sieve reads every charter's public_interface, which 17.13.1 says the check does not read.
traces_to: Outline 17.13.1 and 17.13; RULE 1; Law 4 (the rule is enforced by physics); Law 1 (a settled rule is not re-derived narrower or wider by the check).
how: Rewrite encapsulation_breaches to read each import site's file and target paths only: the source's device is the cairn/devices/<x> segment of its file, the target's the cairn/devices/<y> segment of its target; a row stands iff the target is in a device, the source is not in that device, and the target is not under cairn/devices/<y>/tools/<t>/ whose charter says published_by_device. The undeclared and missing_field reasons are deleted. The proof is rewritten in place, red-first.

clauses.claim: tool, machine, skill, proof and device sources importing a module under another device each read exactly one into_device row naming its file, line and module
an import inside one device, between two of its machines or into a sibling machine's private module, reads no row
an import of any module under a device tool whose charter says published_by_device reads no row, and the same tool without published_by_device reads one into_device row

a charter with no public_interface, and an import of a non-device tool's module its public_interface does not list, read no row; inspector.py no longer contains the reasons 'undeclared' or 'missing_field'
the rows over the live tree equal an independent path census of import_sieve sites, site for site, and the census is not empty
the build inspector reaches no device and the retired sieves device_isolation_holds and machine_imports_no_device stay retired

decisions.text: D1: encapsulation_breaches keeps its signature and row shape {source, target, reason, file, line, module}. A site counts iff its target's posix path starts cairn/devices/<y>/ (a target of cairn/devices/__init__.py is in no device), its file does not start cairn/devices/<y>/, and the target is not under cairn/devices/<y>/tools/<t>/ whose intention+why.json says published_by_device true. reason is always 'into_device'; source is the innermost component holding the file (None if none), target the innermost component holding the target, else cairn/devices/<y>. No charter's public_interface is read; the missing_field rows are deleted. encapsulation_holds keeps its attribution and its docstring gains the 17.13.1 provenance. WHERE: both functions live in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (encapsulation_breaches near line 4456, encapsulation_holds near 4521); import sites come from import_sieve.import_sites(repo_root) as today. The published check reads <repo_root>/cairn/devices/<y>/tools/<t>/intention+why.json with json.loads and only its published_by_device key; the live published tools today are cairn/devices/librarian/tools/trees/intention+why.json, cairn/devices/db_domain/tools/client/intention+why.json and cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store/intention+why.json.

D2: test_encapsulation_holds.py is rewritten in place, one tooth per clause of this ticket (PROVES keys 1..6), fixtures through cairn.tools.scratch.scratch_dir. 56d1aff4455e's keys 2 and 5 measured claims outline 17.13.1 overturns (an undeclared module reds; a charter without public_interface reds); they move onto this ticket's teeth 4, which measure the superseding claim, so the PROVED ticket's coverage names the answer that replaced it. Its keys 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 76639374d9f9's a and 135a905eac3c's all stay on the teeth that measure them under the path rule. The proof file is cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_encapsulation_holds.py, present today; its red-first form is already on disk (tooth 1 green at HEAD, teeth 2 to 6 red), so the build changes inspector.py only.

out: clearing the 76 standing cross-device reaches (one ticket per importing component, under 8e3474a6ae43)
the RULE 1 prose in CLAUDE.md and CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md, which the parent 8e3474a6ae43 revises to 17.13.1

measured.saw: 79 encapsulation_breaches rows: 76 into_device, 3 undeclared; a pure path census of import_sieve sites read 77, the extra one targeting cairn/devices/__init__.py
measured.how: inspector.encapsulation_breaches('.') and a scratch path census over import_sieve.import_sites('.')
